crossRefs.note: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother…

translations.web: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”
translations.bsb: Then I said to her, “You must live with me for many days; you must not be promiscuous or belong to another, and I will do the same for you.”
translations.kjv: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man:
translations.asv: and I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be any man's wife: so will I also be toward thee.
